title: Shopify–NetSuite Sync for Snack Brands: Match Single Units, Multipacks, and Cases
summary: Map each Shopify variant to a versioned NetSuite pack recipe so a six-pack order lands as twelve units, not a 24-bar grocery case.
body_markdown:
## The operating decision


Snack-brand two-way sync needs an explicit sellable-pack crosswalk. A single bar, a six-pack, and a wholesale case may share a flavor but represent different quantities and prices. Preserve the purchased Shopify variant and map it to the approved NetSuite representation before any order, fulfillment, or finance process uses it.


Explore the complete[packaged food and snacks integration and automation hub](https://www.stacksync.com/industry/cpg/packaged-food-snacks) for the systems and processes around this guide.
